analysis.root_cause: All 645 trades have hedge_state='NO_HEDGE' and hedge_reason='NO_HEDGE_CONTEXT'. Since the system exclusively executes SHORT positions, there is no natural hedge opportunity (would need a LONG position to hedge against). The hedge system is structurally unreachable until LONG trades are enabled.
analysis.activation_requirement: Hedging requires LONG position to pair with SHORT position (or vice versa). With 100% SHORT positions, no hedge pairs can form.

cost_benefit.hedge_would_cost: Estimated 2x round-trip cost (~12 bps) per hedge pair if activated
cost_benefit.hedge_potential_benefit: Tail loss protection on high-volatility events (PORTALUSDT -$7.36 would be partially covered)

rare_event_exposure.note: Without hedging and without LONG positions, the system has no mechanism to offset tail losses on individual symbols. Stop loss is the only floor.
rare_event_exposure.fat_tail_risk: PORTALUSDT: single trade -$7.36 (33% of total $22.23 net PnL). One tail loss can erase significant accumulated profit.

tests_required: test: inject LONG + SHORT on same symbol, verify hedge_lock.py activates properly
test: verify hedge accounting is correct when one leg wins and other loses
test: verify hedge_state transitions from NO_HEDGE → HEDGED → CLOSED
